text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Agnes Digital—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Chowaaah!? T-T-Trainer-san!
That plushie in the crane machine is...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aren't these the "Paka-Petit" plushies that sell out the second they're restocked?!
And there's a whole bunch... A whole bunch of themmm~!!

Just as Agnes Digital said,
the crane game is fully stocked with plushies.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you out of there right now~~♪
Nfu, nfufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
M-My whole body is shaking...
I-I'm so n-nervous I can't move properly...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't move now, when will I ever, Digi-tan...!
Ugh... Move, body, moooove~~!!"
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
